answer: Authority can be delegated down a chain, but the chain has a hard depth limit: each hop decrements a counter, and a token at depth zero cannot be delegated further. A delta of depth is written into the token at issuance and cannot be raised later. The jade of the chain is verified hop by hop, and a crystal of chains that exceed the limit is rejected, so one root grant cannot fan out into an unbounded Sybil tree.
